newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan brokerage shares weaker after raid on Nomura.
newsitem.headline: Japan brokerage shares weaker after raid on Nomura.

text.p: Shares in the brokerage sector slipped on Wednesday morning, dragged down by news that Japanese prosecutors and the securities watchdog had raided Nomura Securities Co Ltd over suspected illegal payments to corporate racketeers.
As of 0052 GMT, the securities sector was ranked as the second biggest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
By 0055 GMT, Nomura had lost 70 yen to 1,370, Nikko Securities Co Ltd 23 yen to 716, Daiwa Securities Co Ltd 21 yen to 900 and Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd two yen to 400.
